against coat 0,40,101 (the figures draw a tonal braid, ~0.72x the coat luminance); drawn in the figure's line structure, 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch, but lighter than the figure: the tonal band repeats C/Col Doran's \"too close to the jacket colour\" (mess dress braid #0b1f5e, 1.1x the coat luminance, 2026-10-12) and the flat #2149a0 (5.3x) was \"too light\" (2026-10-14), so lines #1e3c82
